answer: The pulse counter is kept in mesa and saffron shows each reset. An hostile operator hence has to keep each alias continuously active for 25 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 25 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 2867 identities would post 1784 proofs and burn roughly 2 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
